value.body: NABARD, India's apex bank for agriculture and rural development, recruits Assistant Managers in Grade A. Most posts are in the Rural Development Banking Service, with streams for general candidates and for specialists such as agriculture, animal husbandry, fisheries, forestry, food processing and finance. Officers appraise projects, monitor rural credit and work with banks and state governments.

items.label: Selection stages
items.note: A psychometric test was also part of the 2025 cycle

items.label: Age limit
items.note: Relaxation for SC/ST, OBC and PwBD as per rules

items.label: Minimum marks
items.note: General RDBS stream; specialist streams set their own degree rules

value.title: How you get in
value.body: For the agriculture stream, a degree in agriculture (or a related PG) with the minimum marks in that year's notification. Apply when NABARD releases the Grade A notice, clear the Phase I prelims, Phase II mains (which includes a stream-specific paper) and the interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Posts are few and the exam is competitive; vacancies differ a lot by stream and year.
Agriculture graduates can apply in their specialist stream, which tests their subject knowledge.
Postings are across India, including regional offices and district-level roles.

value.title: NABARD Grade A posts notified
value.note: Totals across all streams (RDBS plus Rajbhasha, Legal or Protocol & Security where advertised); as notified, final numbers can change.
